stories.title: Women building trench dams in Kwale
stories.excerpt: In drought-prone Kwale, women built trench dams to store water for irrigation.
body: In the dry season, Kanana community faced months without reliable water. Pastor leaders mobilised women from five Shalom groups to plan and build trench dams — a community-led solution that stores rainwater for irrigation.

Within one season, 14 water initiatives were completed. Farming groups diversified crops and household income rose an estimated 22%. The project exemplifies how pastor-led networks translate citizenship values into tangible community assets.
Tracking data shows Kanana has advanced to Implementation stage with a leadership score of 81 — one of the highest in the Kwale South catchment.

stories.title: Mary Mvilera's scone business
stories.excerpt: At 35, Mary started a scone business after PA programmes.
body: Mary Mvilera joined an Economic Productivity CHIP group in Benga after her pastor introduced PA's person-to-person skill transfer model. She learned baking, pricing, and basic bookkeeping.
Starting with a single oven, Mary now supplies scones to three local schools and employs two neighbours. Her story has been replicated in two neighbouring communities.
Benga's CBC economic dimension score of 80 reflects the impact of livelihood programmes across Nkhotakota South.

stories.title: Pastor Abdisa amid conflict
stories.excerpt: Pastor-led ministry continues with courage in conflict-affected Ethiopia.
body: Pastor Abdisa leads a network of 11 communities across Hossana, Gurage, and Durame catchments in Ethiopia. Despite regional challenges, pastor leaders coordinate discipleship and community health outreaches.

PA's Transformational Leadership programme provided structured training that helped pastors navigate crisis while sustaining community engagement. Shalom groups are now forming in three new locations.
Ethiopia's network readiness is at Engagement stage on average, with leadership scores trending upward (+9% YoY).

stories.title: A young pastor growing church and crops
stories.excerpt: Pastor Chaambwa grows crops alongside leading his church.
body: Pastor Chaambwa models economic productivity by farming alongside his congregation in Zambia's emerging network. Crop diversification demonstrations on church land have inspired four farming groups.
The community is at Awareness stage but showing early signs of readiness for structured leadership training. Agriculture sector scores are the strongest dimension in Zambia's CBC index.
Resource mobilization guidance identifies water access as the next priority investment for this catchment.

stories.title: Ministry beyond the church walls
stories.excerpt: After MI training in Arusha, Pastor Timothy expanded ministry to resolve community challenges beyond preaching.
body: Pastor Timothy Msengi leads transformation work in Tanzania's emerging PA network. Training in Arusha challenged pastors to address whole-community needs — water, education, and local conflict mediation.
Six PPP projects are now tracked across the Tanzania network, with pastors coordinating volunteers and local leaders in three regions.
Network readiness is at Engagement stage with +5% growth year over year as new pastor cohorts complete foundational training.

stories.title: Holistic church development in Burundi network
stories.excerpt: Pastor leaders learn to equip congregations for work that breaks cycles of poverty.
body: Rwanda's emerging pastor network is applying holistic ministry training to help churches take up productive work alongside discipleship.
Four tracked PPP initiatives connect leadership development with livelihood programmes as the network establishes its first catchment structures.
Field data shows readiness climbing as pastors report increased confidence in coordinating community-wide transformation.

stories.title: Whole-person ministry in practice
stories.excerpt: MI training helped pastors imagine ministry that addresses the whole person before programmes even ended.
body: Pastor Etiene Mahembe and peers in Burundi began reimagining church ministry during MI training — connecting spiritual discipleship with practical community engagement.
Two PPP projects are active with Shalom group formation beginning in pilot communities.
Burundi's network is at early Awareness stage with leadership scores trending upward as training cohorts complete.
